Black bear harvest counts by bear management unit/hunting district from FWP's annual black bear harvest reports (mandatory harvest reporting). Rows per season (methodLabel 'Spring & Fall seasons', 'Spring season', 'Fall season') and residency. FWP does not publish hunter numbers by district, so hunters and success are null; statewide license sales are given as licenses on the Statewide combined-season rows. Regional and BMU-area (Central/East/Northwest/Southwest/West) roll-ups are omitted; 2025 lists '700 With Hounds' as its own area (kept as its own unit, not part of '700'). Rows FWP listed with unknown or unlabeled residency (2020, 2023) are omitted from resident/nonresident but are included in FWP's Sum rows.

Reported mountain lion harvest (mandatory reporting) by hunting district (2020-2023) and by lion management unit (2024-2025, FWP 'Area/LMU'; ids are similar 3-digit numbers but boundaries changed, so compare across that break with care). FWP publishes no lion hunter numbers by area; hunters and success are null; statewide license sales are given as licenses on Statewide rows. 2024-2025 rows note harvest with/without hounds. Regional, ecoregion and unknown ('2**', '6**', '7**') rows are omitted.

FWP reports turkey harvest by county (unit = county as FWP writes it, e.g. 'Lewis_and_Clark'; unitNames gives the county name), not by hunting district. Survey estimates are published with decimals and copied unrounded. Rows per season (combined/spring/fall) with hunters and days from FWP's effort sheet, plus harvest by license/permit type (hunt = FWP LPT code such as '799-00', or General_License / Regional_License) where hunters are not published. Success % is published statewide only (percent of license holders who hunted that harvested at least one turkey); county success is null because turkey licenses allow more than one bird, so harvest/hunters would not be a success rate. Fall harvest includes birds FWP did not classify by sex, so harvestMale + harvestFemale can be less than harvest. Regional and county-unknown rows omitted, so county sums fall short of Statewide. FWP's hunter_success sheet definition mentions 'pronghorn' (a template typo in FWP's workbook); it is the turkey success figure.
